cards.title: Introduction to Archaeology
cards.desc: Meet the tools of the trade and handle a display of real finds before the first trowel goes in.

cards.title: Big Dig Workshop
cards.desc: Excavate a full-size dig site and uncover the artefacts people left behind thousands of years ago.

cards.title: Skeleton Excavation
cards.desc: Brush back the soil around a buried skeleton and work out the story its bones are telling.

cards.title: Monastic Site
cards.desc: Dig into how Ireland's early monks lived and find the traces their settlements left in the ground.

cards.title: Treasure Hunt
cards.desc: Follow clues across the camp, solve the challenges along the way and track down the hidden hoard.

cards.title: And Much More…
cards.desc: Mesolithic hut building, Dolmen workshop, Monastic Cross carving & more secrets to uncover!

cards.title: Witches' Cauldron Pot
cards.desc: Shape the Cailleach's cauldron from raw clay using the pinch-pot method potters used in the Stone Age.

cards.title: Viking Beads Workshop
cards.desc: Thread a string of glass beads into a necklace any Viking trader would have been proud to carry.

cards.title: Halloween Lanterns
cards.desc: Make a lantern to light the dark half of the year, the way Samhain was marked long before pumpkins.

cards.title: Witches & Wizards Wands
cards.desc: Carve and decorate a wand of your own, then put it to work in a bit of camp sorcery.

cards.title: Medieval & Viking Shields
cards.desc: Build a battle-ready shield and paint it with your own Viking or medieval design.

cards.title: Coin-Striking & Pouches
cards.desc: Strike a real metal coin, then hand-stitch a leather belt pouch to carry it home in.

cards.title: And Much More…
cards.desc: Mummer masks, Viking spears, Stone Age axes, Ogham pendants, mosaics & weaving!

cards.title: Archery & Sword Fighting
cards.desc: Safe target practice and padded sword duels — train the way a medieval warrior would have.

cards.title: Werewolf Charge
cards.desc: One werewolf, a field of villagers and a howl before every charge. Cross the field if you dare!

cards.title: Bat, Bat, Cat
cards.desc: Duck, duck, goose with fangs — sit tight in the circle and hope you're the one picked as the cat.

cards.title: Mummy Wrap
cards.desc: Teams race to wrap one brave volunteer head to toe in toilet paper. Fastest mummy wins.

cards.title: Mummies & Wool Ghosts
cards.desc: Quieter making games between digs: a mummy built from cardboard, a ghost spun out of wool.

cards.title: And More Spooky Fun…
cards.desc: Word searches, pumpkin colouring, team challenges & Friday dress-up for every child and staff member!
